items.name: 1910 Alto Cocktail 17cl
items.description: The Alto is a tall, elegant cocktail glass that redefines sophistication with its refined lines and graceful form. Designed for cocktails that deserve a striking presentation, the Alto stands out with an extended, slender stem and a tall, lead free crystal bowl. The delicately etched 1910 design around the bowl really accentuates the drink’s colour and clarity. Translated from 16th Century Italian meaning "high", the Alto is a sleek, modern tall-stemmed glass designed to elevate any drinking experience with its refined silhouette. Perfectly suited for sophisticated settings, this glass combines aesthetic allure with functionality, making it an ideal choice for both formal and casual gatherings. Lead-free crystal - FDA approved glass with no toxic additives Thermal shock resistance Mechanical shock resistance Cut and polished rim for finer tasting High transparency to accentuate the colour of the contents Pulled stem - seamless for premium visual appreciation Dishwasher safe see our Crystal Glass Care Guide for more information

items.name: Retro Nick & Nora Cocktail Glass 17cl
items.description: With an elegant design, the retro Nick & Nora Glass brings sophistication to any serve. Made from lead-free crystal, this cocktail glass features brilliant transparency to accentuate the contents in a minimal drink presentation. This high level of clarity in the material is paired with an elegantly delicate stem, contrasting with the comparatively large bowl on top. Inspired by vintage 1930s design, this cocktail glass emerged from classic detective film, The Thin Man. Taking its name from the cocktail loving lead characters, Nick & Nora Charles, this crystal stem glass is the perfect embodiment of prohibition era style. Offering a solution to spill-prone wide rimmed martini glasses, the Nick & Nora cocktail glass has tall walls. This reduces the chance of spillage, ensuring the drinker can enjoy the fruits of your mixology. Product Features Small cocktail stem glass inspired by classic 1930s movie "The Thin Man" Elegant Prohibition era aesthetic Tall walls offer spill-proof alternative to the classic martini glass Lead-free crystal - FDA approved glass with no toxic additives Delicate thin stem Thin walled bowl gives lightweight finish to drinkers High transparency - lasts up to 1500 industrial glasswasher cycles Thermal shock resistance Elegant seamless pulled stem adds beauty and strength Laser treated rim for resistance to chipping Dishwasher safe - see our Crystal Glass Care Guide for more information

items.name: Yansheng Tin-on-Tin Copper Plated Weighted Shaker 85cl
items.description: This tin on tin shaker is made with a classic Asian shape featuring a premium copper finish giving a slightly heavier, more robust shaker. Made with our standard high level of quality steel and featuring laser welded caps on the base of the two tins. Yansheng Coins are talismans of good fortune in China, and often used to bring in money in Feng Shui. These coins are round with a square hole in the centre. They represent both heaven (the circle) and earth (the square), and because of this, they are deemed especially auspicious. Features Lucky Coins on the base Made from premium 18/8 Japanese steel for greater corrosion resistance Weighted base on each tin for increased rigidity Outlasts standard poor grade steel shakers Polished Copper Plated finish Gift boxed Dishwasher safe - see our Steel Care Guide page for more information

Yansheng Coins are talismans of good fortune in China, and often used to bring in money in Feng Shui. These coins are round with a square hole in the centre. They represent both heaven (the circle) and earth (the square), and because of this, they are deemed especially auspicious.
  • Features Lucky Coins on the base

  • Weighted base on each tin for increased rigidity
  • Outlasts standard poor grade steel shakers
  • Polished finish
  • Gift boxed
  • Dishwasher safe - see our Steel Care Guide page for more information

items.name: 1910 Gin Balloon Glass 65cl
items.description: Made from lead-free crystal, the 1910 Gin Balloon Glass is made for premium drink presentation. Due to the high grade material, this copa de balon has a high level of transparency. This high quality material synergises with the etched pattern around the bowl to create a delicate interaction with the atmospheric light. Inspired by the Lady Hamilton Pall Mall glassware, this contemporary cocktail glass exudes a vintage aesthetic. Consequently, this unique retro pattern harks back to prohibition era drinking, fitting well with art deco design. Product Features Copa de balon style stemmed gin balloon glass Elegant Prohibition era aesthetic with etched pattern inspired by classic Pall Mall glassware Big capacity for mixers or extra ice Lead-free crystal - FDA approved glass with no toxic additives Thin walled bowl gives lightweight finish to drinkers High transparency - lasts up to 1500 industrial glasswasher cycles Thermal shock resistance Elegant seamless pulled stem adds beauty and strength Laser treated rim for resistance to chipping Dishwasher safe - see our Crystal Glass Care Guide for more information
items.descriptionHtml:
Made from lead-free crystal, the 1910 Gin Balloon Glass is made for premium drink presentation. Due to the high grade material, this copa de balon has a high level of transparency. This high quality material synergises with the etched pattern around the bowl to create a delicate interaction with the atmospheric light. Inspired by the Lady Hamilton Pall Mall glassware, this contemporary cocktail glass exudes a vintage aesthetic. Consequently, this unique retro pattern harks back to prohibition era drinking, fitting well with art deco design.

Product Features

  • Copa de balon style stemmed gin balloon glass
  • Elegant Prohibition era aesthetic with etched pattern inspired by classic Pall Mall glassware
  • Big capacity for mixers or extra ice
  • Lead-free crystal - FDA approved glass with no toxic additives
  • Thin walled bowl gives lightweight finish to drinkers
  • High transparency - lasts up to 1500 industrial glasswasher cycles
  • Thermal shock resistance
  • Elegant seamless pulled stem adds beauty and strength
  • Laser treated rim for resistance to chipping
  • Dishwasher safe - see our Crystal Glass Care Guide for more information

items.name: 1910 Umbo Flute 20cl
items.description: The Umbo 1910 collection reinterprets the Umbo silhouette through a vintage lens. Featuring a delicately etched pattern inspired by early 20th-century glassmaking, each piece combines classic detailing with modern crystalline clarity. The result is a range that feels timeless, elegant and quietly decorative — ideal for refined cocktail service, sparkling drinks and select dessert presentations. The name Umbo, derived from Latin and meaning the rounded centre of a shield , reflects the balanced proportions at the heart of each design, while 1910 references the era that inspired its decorative detailing. The Umbo 1910 Flute brings vintage elegance to sparkling wines and Champagne cocktails. Delicate etched detailing complements the tall, slender form, while the crystalline glass preserves effervescence and clarity. A classic choice for celebratory serves with a heritage feel.

items.name: 1910 Umbo 26cl
items.description: The Umbo 1910 collection reinterprets the Umbo silhouette through a vintage lens. Featuring a delicately etched pattern inspired by early 20th-century glassmaking, each piece combines classic detailing with modern crystalline clarity. The result is a range that feels timeless, elegant and quietly decorative — ideal for refined cocktail service, sparkling drinks and select dessert presentations. The name Umbo, derived from Latin and meaning the rounded centre of a shield, reflects the balanced proportions at the heart of each design, while 1910 references the era that inspired its decorative detailing. With slightly increased capacity, the Umbo 1910 26cl is ideal for versatile cocktail service. The subtle etched detailing catches the light beautifully, elevating both classic and contemporary serves. A well-proportioned option for cocktails and light dessert presentations where elegance is key.

items.name: Umbo 26cl
items.description: The Umbo range pairs contemporary elegance with everyday versatility. Crafted from high-quality crystalline for exceptional clarity and brilliance, each glass is designed to elevate cocktails, spritzes and creative serves — with just enough versatility to suit lighter dessert presentations when needed. The name Umbo comes from Latin, meaning the rounded centre of a shield, a subtle nod to the balanced proportions and confident silhouette that define the range. The Umbo 26cl offers added flexibility, making it perfect for a wider range of cocktails, spritzes and creative serves. The gently proportioned bowl allows aromas to open beautifully, while the crystal clarity ensures every drink looks as good as it tastes. Suitable for light dessert presentations when a refined touch is desired.

items.name: Verdot Crystal Champagne Flute 20cl
items.description: The classic curves of the Verdot Champagne Flute add elegance to everyday champagne service. Made form lead-free crystal glass, this stemware is dishwasher safe, therefore making it an ideal addition to restaurant drinks service. Because of the premium design, this crystal flute has high transparency for appreciation of champagnes and sparkling wines. In addition, the classically tall bowl has a subtle taper towards the rim to direct the contents towards the tongue. While the Verdot Flute promotes high aesthetics, the manufacturing process gives it mechanical and thermal shock resistance. As a result, this premium flute makes the perfect addition to any existing table setting. items.name: Vintage Irish Coffee Glass 17cl
items.description: Bring a touch of heritage to your drinks service with this Irish Coffee Glass. With its classic 17cl stemmed design, this glass is perfect for serving the world-famous Irish Coffee in true vintage style. Beyond Irish Coffee, its versatile bowl and elegant stem make it ideal for a wide variety of drinks and desserts — from Mimosas and Orange Fizz cocktails to Grasshoppers, layered liqueurs, or even indulgent desserts. The stem keeps hands comfortably cool while the gently curved shape enhances both presentation and drinking experience. A timeless choice for bars, restaurants, or home entertaining, this glass blends vintage charm with everyday practicality.

Used by bartenders across the world, this measure is CE marked for use in licenced bars. Made from Japanese 18/8 stainless steel, this double measure has a polished mirror finish. items.name: Calabrese Stainless Steel Hawthorne Cocktail Strainer 20.5cm
items.description: In conjunction with Salvatore Calabrese, Urban Bar created the Calabrese hawthorne Strainer. This strainer combines the best materials with the knowledge of the greatest bartender in the world. For use with a cocktail shaker tin, this strainer also works well with the Calabrese Shaker. This strainer sits inside the tin where it can hold the ice back and allows a clean pour from the shaker rim. On the handle is a divot which helps the strainer hold on the rim of the tin. Made from high grade Japanese steel, the Calabrese Strainer has a polished finish. With Salvatore's keen eye for mixology, this luxury strainer raises the visuals of your cocktail making. items.name: Classic Stainless Steel Bar Spoon 27cm — Engraving
items.description: The Classic Bar Spoon is an essential of any bar kit. A great all round tool, this spoon allows you to stir, gently muddle and layer drinks. Urban Bar have enhanced this basic tool by making it from high grade 18/8 Japanese steel. This premium material give the spoon a luxury polished finish, perfect for mixology display. In addition, this spoon has a high level of corrosion resistance, ensuring it outlasts other basic steel bar tools. Using the standard European bar spoon design, this bar tool has a classic twisted stem with a flat disc on the end. The twisted stem is a standard on most bar spoons, giving lots of curves for drinks to flow around during stirring. The corkscrew shape also allows more controlled pouring with a channel perfect for accepting liquid from a free-flow pourer . Because of this, the liquors that flow down the spiral land neatly on the flat disc, allowing them to gently spread. items.name: Geometric Tin-on-Tin Cocktail Shaker
items.description: Geometric Ginza Stone Tin-on-Tin Cocktail Shaker Be part of the first chapter in an exciting collaboration between Urban Bar and InkedOz with this exclusive Geometric Ginza Tin-on-Tin Cocktail Shaker, available only through the Urban Bar website. Created in partnership with Daniel “Oz” Osborne — known for sharing his bartending expertise online, leading training within hospitality, and championing both professional development and well-being in the industry — this special release celebrates craftsmanship, performance, and the culture of modern bartending. Made from premium 18/8 Japanese steel, the Ginza Tin-on-Tin Cocktail Shaker set includes our Ginza Can and Ginza Cup. Its high-grade steel construction delivers a lighter, more robust finish than standard barware, while offering superior insulation for a colder, more effective shake. Favoured by professional mixologists, it also produces a satisfying rattle as the ice moves through the full steel body, adding a touch of theatre to every serve. A silver-welded base provides added strength, while the steel’s excellent corrosion resistance helps protect against rust for lasting durability. As the very first Urban Bar x InkedOz release, this is an exclusive collaboration piece designed for bartenders who take their craft seriously. Product Features: Professional dual shaker tin set Made from premium 18/8 Japanese steel for greater corrosion resistance Outlasts standard poor grade steel shakers Unique Tumbled Stone Finish Both tins are weighted on the base

items.name: Hawthorn Stainless Steel Cocktail Strainer 20cm — Engraving
items.description: High quality stainless steel hawthorn strainer, made from Japanese 18/8 steel. A classic bar tool improved upon with Urban Bar's design. For use with Boston shaker or mixing glass, this strainer filters out unwanted solid ingredients from cocktails. Cocktail strainers often suffer from poor build quality, however the Perfect Serve cocktail strainer spares no expense in making barware designed to last. A solid rounded handle gives a comfortable grip compared to common flat handled strainers. The premium Japanese steel spring withstands the daily rigours of commercial bar use to strain ice and solid ingredients for multiple drinks. Engraving The Perfect Serve hawthorn Strainer can be engraved in-house at Urban Bar using laser etching for a dishwasher safe finish. We offer 3 lightness options for custom engraving - Light, Medium, and Dark. Please see our Laser Engraving Information page, or contact us for more information. items.name: Biloxi Stainless Steel Strainer Bar Spoon 34.5cm
items.description: The stunning Biloxi Strainer Bar Spoon offers a unique addition to your mixology. With a perforated head, this cocktail spoon allows easy drainage of ice cubes and other wet ingredients to drain excess liquid. Minimising dilution, the Strainer Bar Spoon also acts as a mini cocktail strainer to strain out excess water from built drinks. The head features higher sides than standard bar spoons, making it easier to scoop and pick up ingredients. The tip of this unique bar spoon is flat, with a curved end, replicating the shape of a normal bar spoon head. This retains the ability to pour liquids down the twisted stem to make layered cocktails. In addition, this curved tip doubles as a gentle muddler for bruising solid ingredients. The shaft of the Biloxi bar spoon has a soft, tight twist, giving a comfortable feel when stirring with a mixing glass. Made from Urban Bar's signature 18/8 steel, this cocktail spoon is finished with a premium polished finish, shining out during cocktail making. The high grade material gives excellent corrosion resistance for greater longevity over standard steel barware. items.name: Classic Gold Bar Spoon 27cm — Engraving
items.description: This stunning gold bar spoon makes your mixology stand out in a dark bar setting. The classic European design features a twisted stem and a flat disc end. The corkscrew stem helps you get the best mix while stirring. The shape lets you roll the spoon between your fingers while stirring to rotate the head as it stirs your drink. Also, this twist allows you to pour liquors down the shaft of the spoon to help make layered cocktails. The classic flat disc on the end of this gold bar spoon turns it in to a gentle muddler. Crush soft ingredients such as sugar cubes or soft fruits to release the flavours before stirring. Using 18/8 Japanese steel, this gold bar spoon is made from the finest materials. This high grade stainless steel has a higher corrosion resistance than standard steel barware. This gives it better protection against rust for a longer lifespan. In addition, the premium material gives the spoon a high polished shine, which is reflected in the gold coating. The Gold Classic Bar Spoon has a coating of PVD titanium nitride, giving it the bold gold colouring. This coat also gives the spoon a toughened exterior, affording it higher abrasion and corrosion resistance. Whereas gold plating is likely to scratch, PVD gold coating is more durable. This gold bar spoon will far outlast gold plated bar tools. items.name: Cocktail Sampling Spoon 15cm
items.description: Banish plastic straws from the cocktail sampling process with the stainless steel Cocktail Sampling Spoon. This small cocktail spatula allows a mixologist to taste their creation before being served to the customer, ensuring the final mix is only of the highest quality. The old-fashioned cocktail sampling process involves the quick disposal of a non-compostable plastic straw. This form of cocktail tasting is wasteful and not environmentally friendly. The Cocktail Sampling Spoon offers a reusable tool for scooping a small amount of liquid at a time. This spoon can then be washed and reused, helping reducing a bar's waste, and impact on the environment. items.name: Foravia Euro Strainer
items.description: Refined, reliable, and built for speed — the Foravia Euro Strainer is a professional upgrade to the bartender’s essential tool. Made from premium polished stainless steel, it features a precision-wound spring for superior straining performance, smooth edges for comfort, and a balanced form designed for fast, efficient service. Its universal fit ensures seamless use with most shakers, mixing tins, and mixing glasses, making it a trusted choice behind any bar. The name Foravia — derived from Latin, meaning “for the way” or “for the journey” — reflects the strainer’s purpose: built to accompany bartenders on their craft, service after service. A step up in quality. A mark of intent. The Foravia Euro Strainer is made for those who take the long way — and make it look effortless.

items.name: Sallet Draining Ice Scoop
items.description: The Sallet Draining Ice Scoop is ideal for serving ice cubes and crushed ice. The T shaped hole allows small ice pieces and water to empty from the scoop preventing them from making it to the glass or shaker and diluting the drink. It also has a heavy handle the end of which can be used, when held in the fist to hit and break up larger pieces of ice that get frozen together. Made from high quality polished aluminium, it has an agronomical design making it essential barware for a professional mixologist.

items.name: Coley® Premium Stainless Steel Cocktail Bar Knife 11.5cm Blade
items.description: Our premium mixologists bar knife combines essential cutting elements with stunning aesthetics and an ergonomic design. The Coley Bar Knife features a 4.5 Inch high grade 18/8 steel blade and a premium Swiss Pear wood handle. Easy Slicing The Coley Bar Knife has a part serrated blade for easily making an incision in to fruit skin, with a smooth sharp blade following to finish the slicing action. Double Sided Blade A sharp double-sided blade allows you to change the direction of your cut without awkwardly twisting the knife around; perfect for carving garnishes. Premium Weight Distribution A finger recess in the top of the knife allows you to press down on the blade when cutting, putting more weight on the fruit you are cutting. With the double-sided blade, this also keeps your finger safe from the sharp steel blade. Longevity Styled after the best chef's knives, the Coley Bar Knife is made from a single piece of steel that continues through the length of the handle. This ensures there are no weak points, making this knife far outlast standard bar knives. Hygienic Forked tip for handling ingredients, avoiding contact with hands. This reduces flavour contamination by keeping fruit juices from your hands, and increasing hygiene levels by keeping your hands clean. Ergonomic Handle Made from premium Swiss Pear, a premium European hardwood, the handle of the Coley Bar Knife has a stunning red wood colour. The shape of the handle has been refined to provide an ergonomic grip, making cutting a pleasure, not a chore. Product Features: Premium bar knife for cocktail making Blade Length: 4.5 Inch Solid single piece of steel for great longevity Made from high grade 18/8 steel, giving high level of corrosion resistance Forked tip for piercing and picking up ingredients Double sided blade - change the direction of your cut without twisting the knife around Finger recess for precision cutting, to keep your finger safe from the sharp blade, and allow you to apply weight to the top of the blade Part serrated blade for easily making an incision in to fruit skin, with a flat sharp half following to finish the slicing action Comfortable Swiss Pear wood handle with beautiful red colouring Hand wash recommended

items.name: Muddler Bar Spoon 28cm, 2.5ml & 5ml
items.description: The Muddler Bar Spoon was developed with award winning bartender Wayne Collins to give a multi-purpose bar tool. The double sided measuring head lets you measure both 5ml and 2.5ml. The tip is larger and more robust than standard flat end muddlers for far more effective muddling ability. Measure: The spoon is a double-sided measure, approx. 5ml/0.17oz in one side and approx. 2.5ml/0.08oz (a half spoon) in the reverse. It also gives a useful half measure (12.5ml) with 2x 5ml & 1x 2.5ml Perfect for precise mixology. Crushing: The tip of the spoon can be used to crush solid ingredients in the bottom of a glass or cocktail shaker. Stir/Soft Rotation: Push the spoon between thumb and finger to make the spoon head rotate and mix a drink, alternatively plunge with the flat end or simply stir. Layer/Float: Pour down the twisted shank keeping the flat end above the first spirit or hold the bowl end of the spoon in contact with the side of the glass and pour into it allowing the liquor to trickle down the side of the glass and on to the layer below. Product Features: Bar spoon with heavyweight end Double sided head for small measures - 2.5ml and 5ml (approx.) Gives refined measuring for cocktail making Twisted stem for layering - twist is wider than standard spoons for a more comfortable hold Made from 18/8 Japanese steel Lightweight and strong High resistance to corrosion and rusting Dishwasher safe - see our Steel Care Guide page for more information Please Note: For tougher muddling, please browse our Cocktail Muddlers .

products.name: Muddler Bar Spoon 28cm, 2.5ml & 5ml
products.description: The Muddler Bar Spoon was developed with award winning bartender Wayne Collins to give a multi-purpose bar tool. The double sided measuring head lets you measure both 5ml and 2.5ml. The tip is larger and more robust than standard flat end muddlers for far more effective muddling ability. Measure: The spoon is a double-sided measure, approx. 5ml/0.17oz in one side and approx. 2.5ml/0.08oz (a half spoon) in the reverse. It also gives a useful half measure (12.5ml) with 2x 5ml & 1x 2.5ml Perfect for precise mixology. Crushing: The tip of the spoon can be used to crush solid ingredients in the bottom of a glass or cocktail shaker. Stir/Soft Rotation: Push the spoon between thumb and finger to make the spoon head rotate and mix a drink, alternatively plunge with the flat end or simply stir. Layer/Float: Pour down the twisted shank keeping the flat end above the first spirit or hold the bowl end of the spoon in contact with the side of the glass and pour into it allowing the liquor to trickle down the side of the glass and on to the layer below. Product Features: Bar spoon with heavyweight end Double sided head for small measures - 2.5ml and 5ml (approx.) Gives refined measuring for cocktail making Twisted stem for layering - twist is wider than standard spoons for a more comfortable hold Made from 18/8 Japanese steel Lightweight and strong High resistance to corrosion and rusting Dishwasher safe - see our Steel Care Guide page for more information Please Note: For tougher muddling, please browse our Cocktail Muddlers .

products.name: Vintage Irish Coffee Glass 17cl- B6
products.description: Bring a touch of heritage to your drinks service with this Irish Coffee Glass. With its classic 17cl stemmed design, this glass is perfect for serving the world-famous Irish Coffee in true vintage style. Beyond Irish Coffee, its versatile bowl and elegant stem make it ideal for a wide variety of drinks and desserts — from Mimosas and Orange Fizz cocktails to Grasshoppers, layered liqueurs, or even indulgent desserts. The stem keeps hands comfortably cool while the gently curved shape enhances both presentation and drinking experience. A timeless choice for bars, restaurants, or home entertaining, this glass blends vintage charm with everyday practicality.

products.name: Retro Nick & Nora Cocktail Glass 17cl
products.description: With an elegant design, the retro Nick & Nora Glass brings sophistication to any serve. Made from lead-free crystal, this cocktail glass features brilliant transparency to accentuate the contents in a minimal drink presentation. This high level of clarity in the material is paired with an elegantly delicate stem, contrasting with the comparatively large bowl on top. Inspired by vintage 1930s design, this cocktail glass emerged from classic detective film, The Thin Man. Taking its name from the cocktail loving lead characters, Nick & Nora Charles, this crystal stem glass is the perfect embodiment of prohibition era style. Offering a solution to spill-prone wide rimmed martini glasses, the Nick & Nora cocktail glass has tall walls. This reduces the chance of spillage, ensuring the drinker can enjoy the fruits of your mixology.   • A premium stainless steel cocktail shaker, designed for effortless mixing and perfect pours.
  • A sleek cocktail spoon, essential for stirring and layering with precision.

Whether you're perfecting a classic martini or experimenting with new recipes, this set is the perfect companion for hosting or gifting to cocktail enthusiasts. Stylish and functional, it’s the ultimate addition to any home bar.

products.name: Yansheng Tin-on-Tin Copper Plated Weighted Shaker 85cl
products.description: This tin on tin shaker is made with a classic Asian shape featuring a premium copper finish giving a slightly heavier, more robust shaker. Made with our standard high level of quality steel and featuring laser welded caps on the base of the two tins. Yansheng Coins are talismans of good fortune in China, and often used to bring in money in Feng Shui. These coins are round with a square hole in the centre. They represent both heaven (the circle) and earth (the square), and because of this, they are deemed especially auspicious. Features Lucky Coins on the base Made from premium 18/8 Japanese steel for greater corrosion resistance Weighted base on each tin for increased rigidity Outlasts standard poor grade steel shakers Polished Copper Plated finish Gift boxed Dishwasher safe - see our Steel Care Guide page for more information

products.name: Sallet Draining Ice Scoop
products.description: The Sallet Draining Ice Scoop is ideal for serving ice cubes and crushed ice. The T shaped hole allows small ice pieces and water to empty from the scoop preventing them from making it to the glass or shaker and diluting the drink. It also has a heavy handle the end of which can be used, when held in the fist to hit and break up larger pieces of ice that get frozen together. Made from high quality polished aluminium, it has an agronomical design making it essential barware for a professional mixologist.

products.description: Ginza Tin-on-Tin Cocktail Shaker Step up your mixology with the Ginza Tin-on-Tin Cocktail Shaker. Made from premium Japanese steel, this set consists of our Ginza Can and Ginza Cup. Steel has better insulating qualities than glass, giving a more effective chill during shaking. This economical aspect makes it the preferred choice of professional mixologists. As well as its practical uses, the full steel material gives a musical rattle as the ice moves around the shaker. Both Ginza shaker tins have a weighted base for flair bartenders. This base is silver welded for a stronger connection. The 18/8 Japanese steel is far more premium than standard steel barware, giving it a lightweight, robust finish. This high grade material has great corrosion resistance, protecting it from rust, making it outlast other barware. products.name: Coley® Premium Stainless Steel Cocktail Bar Knife 11.5cm Blade
products.description: Our premium mixologists bar knife combines essential cutting elements with stunning aesthetics and an ergonomic design. The Coley Bar Knife features a 4.5 Inch high grade 18/8 steel blade and a premium Swiss Pear wood handle. Easy Slicing The Coley Bar Knife has a part serrated blade for easily making an incision in to fruit skin, with a smooth sharp blade following to finish the slicing action. Double Sided Blade A sharp double-sided blade allows you to change the direction of your cut without awkwardly twisting the knife around; perfect for carving garnishes. Premium Weight Distribution A finger recess in the top of the knife allows you to press down on the blade when cutting, putting more weight on the fruit you are cutting. With the double-sided blade, this also keeps your finger safe from the sharp steel blade. Longevity Styled after the best chef's knives, the Coley Bar Knife is made from a single piece of steel that continues through the length of the handle. This ensures there are no weak points, making this knife far outlast standard bar knives. Hygienic Forked tip for handling ingredients, avoiding contact with hands. This reduces flavour contamination by keeping fruit juices from your hands, and increasing hygiene levels by keeping your hands clean. Ergonomic Handle Made from premium Swiss Pear, a premium European hardwood, the handle of the Coley Bar Knife has a stunning red wood colour. The shape of the handle has been refined to provide an ergonomic grip, making cutting a pleasure, not a chore. products.name: Classic Stainless Steel Bar Spoon 27cm — No Engraving
products.description: The Classic Bar Spoon is an essential of any bar kit. A great all round tool, this spoon allows you to stir, gently muddle and layer drinks. Urban Bar have enhanced this basic tool by making it from high grade 18/8 Japanese steel. This premium material give the spoon a luxury polished finish, perfect for mixology display. In addition, this spoon has a high level of corrosion resistance, ensuring it outlasts other basic steel bar tools. Using the standard European bar spoon design, this bar tool has a classic twisted stem with a flat disc on the end. The twisted stem is a standard on most bar spoons, giving lots of curves for drinks to flow around during stirring. The corkscrew shape also allows more controlled pouring with a channel perfect for accepting liquid from a free-flow pourer . Because of this, the liquors that flow down the spiral land neatly on the flat disc, allowing them to gently spread. The flat disc can also be used for gentle bruising of ingredients such as sugar cubes or soft fruit. products.description: This stunning gold bar spoon makes your mixology stand out in a dark bar setting. The classic European design features a twisted stem and a flat disc end. Also, this twist allows you to pour liquors down the shaft of the spoon to help make layered cocktails. The classic flat disc on the end of this gold bar spoon turns it in to a gentle muddler. This high grade stainless steel has a higher corrosion resistance than standard steel barware. This gives it better protection against rust for a longer lifespan. In addition, the premium material gives the spoon a high polished shine, which is reflected in the gold coating. The Gold Classic Bar Spoon has a coating of PVD titanium nitride, giving it the bold gold colouring. This coat also gives the spoon a toughened exterior, affording it higher abrasion and corrosion resistance. Whereas gold plating is likely to scratch, PVD gold coating is more durable. This gold bar spoon will far outlast gold plated bar tools.
